**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** No insurance language exists anywhere — searches for "insurance", "coverage", "insurer" returned nothing responsive (only an IP indemnity hit at p0090). I read all three planner candidates: § 20 General Matters (p0135–p0147) has time-of-essence, notices, waiver, assignment, independent contractor, force majeure, severability, governing law and headings, but no insurance covenant; § 4 and § 9 confirm Garman installs Software and converts Sparkling's data at the Authorized Locations with on-site project personnel. There is no defined "Customer Data" term.
- **Target level:** Fallback (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber and privacy USD 2,000,000) — the shortest complete cure. I deliberately omitted preferred-only items (CGL limits, workers' compensation, certificates) and the model language's "at its own expense"/one-year tail, which no selected element requires.
- **Redline:** One `insert_after` at p0147 adding new § 20(j); validated `ok:true` with the minimality gate clean, and both fallback elements mapped once each.
